query: SELECT l.id as lid, l.title, l.languageCode, COUNT(e.id) as ex_count FROM lessons l LEFT JOIN exercises e ON e.lessonId = l.id GROUP BY l.id ORDER BY ex_count ASC LIMIT 15; SELECT id, lessonId, question, correctAnswer, options FROM exercises WHERE lessonId IN (SELECT id FROM lessons WHERE languageCode LIKE 'en%') LIMIT 10;
